photo_findings.shows: An oblique rear view of the tractor's drive-axle tires, rear mudguard and lamp-and-plate carrier, with most coupling and chassis detail outside the frame.

issues.observation: The near-side tank face has a broad shallow inward dent ahead of the vertical strap; the strap remains aligned and no split or wet diesel trace is visible.
issues.severity_reason: A shallow local tank dent with an aligned strap and no leak is a petty-cash issue, not a moderate tank repair.

issues.observation: The near-side fuel tank has a broad, sharply creased inward deformation across its front half; no wet staining or active leak is visible, but the tank and its seams require inspection for replacement planning.

strengths: The visible drive-tire pair carries substantial, broadly even tread with no visible sidewall bulge or cracking.
The rear mudguard and its visible mounting points are present and appear straight.
The visible rear lamp cluster is complete, with no cracked or missing lens apparent.
The visible drive-tire crowns retain deep, similarly worn block tread with no obvious cupping or localized shoulder scrub.
Visible chassis rails and crossmembers retain attached paint without lifting scale, pitting, cracking or deformation.
The visible steer rim is straight, and the hub area appears dry.
The visible catwalk section is present and appears straight; the fuel-tank strap remains seated.
The visible drive duals are matched in size and carry similarly pronounced tread with no obvious shoulder collapse, exposed cords or sidewall bulges.
cannot_tell: The fifth-wheel plate, throat, jaws and grease condition are not visible; a raised rear three-quarter view over the chassis is required.
The catwalk and suzie coils are outside the frame; a view directly behind the cab is required.
The chassis rail ends and crossmembers are obscured, so paint condition, scaling corrosion and repairs cannot be assessed.
The air bags, air tanks, lines and drain valves are not visible; a clear side-underbody view is required.
Full matching across the drive axle cannot be confirmed because tire branding and the opposite-side tires are not shown clearly.

One outer drive tire also has pronounced shoulder wear and tread-block chunking, while the other visible drive tires retain substantial, broadly even tread.
condition_summary.wheels_brakes: Visible rims are straight and hubs dry; one drive rim has only paint chips and light surface rust. Brake discs, drums and linings were not visible.
condition_summary.fifth_wheel_coupling: The fifth-wheel plate is complete with a visible grease film and no gross distortion; catwalk sections and suzie coils are present. Throat wear, jaws, locking action and mounting play were not assessable.
condition_summary.chassis_corrosion: Visible rails and crossmembers retain attached paint without scaling corrosion or deformation. A possible broad dent in the near-side fuel tank was inconsistently reported, with no visible leak and other views appearing straight; the full underside, air system and suspension remain unassessed.
condition_summary.body_paint: Cab panels sit square with parallel gaps, consistent red paint and intact aerodynamic trim. The rear cab wall has a small superficial scuff or residue line without distortion or visible corrosion.
condition_summary.cab_interior: Seats, bunks, storage and trim generally retain their shape and show ordinary working-cab use; the raised bunk has light soiling. The steering-wheel rim has localized heavy polish and abrasion, but no exposed core or distortion is visible.
condition_summary.engine_driveline: Mechanical condition is not assessable from these photos because the engine bay and driveline underside were not shown. The live cluster recorded 164374 km with no engine, ABS/EBS, emissions or brake-system fault lamp visible while the engine was stopped; fuel was empty and required refilling.
condition_summary.glass_lights: The windscreen, mirrors, headlamps and rear lamp clusters appear complete and free of visible cracking.

adjustment.basis: capped at one residual standard deviation of the price model (+/-5.4%) - the variation in asking price that year, kilometres, brand and market and what the model costs new do not explain
adjustment.cap_basis: measured: one out-of-fold residual standard deviation of the price model (+/-5.4%) - the variation in asking price that year, kilometres, brand and market and what the model costs new do not explain
adjustment.weights_basis: assumed, not fitted: the severity x impact weight table, the per-subsystem saturation decay, the family value weights and the coverage thresholds are all hand-set. This corpus carries no condition ground truth to fit them against, so they are stated rather than measured
notes: 30% of the truck was affirmed sound, but a finding the model itself rates real cancels the premium - a truck with one thing badly wrong is not paid a premium for the rest of it being clean

asking.label: in line with the market
asking.summary: The asking price sits inside the band that comparable trucks of this age and mileage are listed at.

widened: only 74% of the truck by value was photographed legibly, so the condition band widens 1.09x (an assumption, not a measurement)
caveats: Trained on ASKING prices, not realised sale prices - the honest caveat, not a hidden one. Expect realised prices to sit below the band.

The measured interval coverage belongs to the comparable-asking band. The condition-adjusted band is that estimate moved by what the photos show, which is a deliberate departure from what sellers ask and is not covered by the same measurement.
Turkish prices converted at 48.596 TRY/USD as of 2026-09-11; at ~30% annual inflation this rate goes stale fast - refit rather than quote it later.
The Turkish comparables are brand-concentrated (78 of 84 Turkish listings are FORD), so an unfamiliar make is priced off the market average rather than off its own curve.
